correctedCritiques.pro-evolved-implicit-guidance: Strongest feature: The reply contests naive factual immediacy, arguing that evolutionarily formed interpretive structures condition perception, interpretation, and moral intuition before explicit causal reasoning begins. Principal limitation: Evolutionary origin establishes neither normative authority, religious embodiment, nor superior reliability; moreover, saying these structures cannot derive from presently available facts needs a sharper derivational account. Live burden: The argument must specify those structures, demonstrate religious narratives preserve them, explain correction under environmental change, and distinguish indispensable cognitive priors from inherited biases warranting evidence-sensitive revision. Locked score: The strong/competent band rewards direct contact with secular sufficiency, coherent mediation, central relevance, and acknowledgment of shared accuracy-seeking, tempered by limited warrant and an incomplete bridge from evolved priors to religious guidance.
